svg.text: ⚠ Degaussing = NO effect on: SSDs | Flash | Optical
Only works on magnetic media (HDD, tape)
Works if device has hardware encryption
SSD Rule: Secure Erase or Crypto Erasure only
✓ effective | ✗ no effect | ~ partial | — not applicable | * if encrypted
Exam: Delete + empty Recycle Bin ≠ destroyed | RAID ≠ backup | Degaussing = magnetic only | SSD → Secure Erase, not multi-pass
